title: Workflow Registry Full React Parity And Jinja Removal

specify.notes: Created the active Spec 040 specification from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers full React workflow registry parity, old workflow route compatibility, workflow-owned Jinja deletion evidence, dual-auth validation, redaction, and retention of non-workflow/shared Jinja infrastructure for later specs.

auto_clarifications: Redirect /admin/workflows and /admin/workflows/ui to /admin/app/workflows with authorized tenant/query/filter/saved-filter/return intent preservation.
Use stable React workflow routes for create, draft editing, revision history, and published version detail, backed by server-owned workflow contracts.

Preserve workflow lineage, draft, revision, published version, publish-gate, evidence, and stale-conflict identifiers when old URLs redirect; return non-Jinja safe problems when unsafe or unauthorized.
Validate both graph preview and keyboard-readable/list alternatives for nodes, edges, validation findings, and publish blockers.
Convert legacy workflow form posts to backend JSON or redirect compatibility handlers; delete workflow_studio.js or workflow-only assets only after scanner and route tests prove no references remain.

plan.notes: Planned workflow React parity by extending the Spec 030 builder contracts, adding workflow list/create/detail/version/revision/publish-gate direct-link coverage, legacy URL redirects/non-Jinja compatibility responses, scanner-backed workflow template/static deletion, dual-auth tests, Playwright evidence, QA docs, and rollback notes.

tasks.notes: Generated dependency-ordered, file-specific tasks covering setup, tests-first workflow React parity, legacy redirect/compatibility handling, workflow-owned Jinja template/static deletion or retained blockers, QA docs, Spec QA, and Playwright validation.
